name: Patna Cube Challenge 2026

information:
## This Competition features Dual Rounds for 3x3, check [Dual Rounds Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PatnaCubeChallenge2026#78031-3x3-dual-rounds) for more information.
*  **Participants must bring their own cubes.**
*  **DON'T BRING MORE THAN ONE GUEST WITH YOU**
* Make sure to be available at the venue at least 30 minutes before your event starts. Late entries won't be allowed to participate.
* If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time or unaware of competition rules, make sure that you attend the tutorial session.
* If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time, please bring your goverment ID card for verification
* Participants are expected to volunteer and will be assigned with roles as judges, scramblers, or runners, with the exception of newcomers.
* **OTS will be only accepted for 3x3x3, 2x2x2 and Pyraminx.**


**Addition of Any Round will be as Per Organizer/ Delegate Discretion**
